summary: Pivot project scope from an AI girlfriend chat app to a simple personal website/landing page that, on open, shows only the user's name and website name: "Iman limbu".
architectural_notes: Deployment domain/slug must be 5–50 characters and contain only letters, numbers, and hyphens (no parentheses).
known_issues: Current deployment/domain name includes parentheses, causing repeated validation errors: must be 5–50 chars and only letters, numbers, and hyphens.

existing_features.title: Build a single-page conversational companion app (“AI girlfriend”) where the user can chat with a friendly, romantic-but-respectful persona via a message thread UI (send message, see replies, timestamps, and basic typing indicator).

Implement an on-device (non-LLM) reply engine that generates companion responses using deterministic rules: (1) intent detection via keyword matching, (2) a persona style guide (tone, vocabulary, boundaries), and (3) controlled randomness from a curated response library so replies feel varied without using any external AI/LLM services.

Add user-configurable companion settings: companion name, relationship “vibe” (e.g., Sweet, Playful, Supportive), and conversation style (Short / Balanced / Long). Settings must immediately affect generated replies.
Create a coherent, cozy visual theme suitable for a romantic companion app (warm neutrals, soft gradients, gentle typography, rounded cards) and apply it consistently across the app UI.
Generate and add required static visual assets (avatar + small UI accents) and render them from frontend static assets (not via backend).
Change the browser tab/page title to exactly "Iman limbu".
Replace the current app UI with a minimal landing page so that on initial load the only visible on-page text is exactly "Iman limbu" (no buttons, no chat UI, no footer text, no other labels).

new_feature_requests.summary: Create an AI girlfriend app (conversational companion)
Persist chat history per authenticated user in the Motoko backend (Internet Identity) with APIs to: get current conversation, append a message, and clear conversation.
Create a minimal landing page where the only visible content on load is the name/title "Iman limbu" (as both the page/website name and displayed text).
